Each app below runs one of the textbook's BASIC programs, rewritten in Python, right
in your browser. Click an app to open it.

**Leaving feedback:** on any app page, highlight the text you want to comment on and
choose **Annotate** in the pop-up, or open the sidebar on the right edge of the page.
